method.sampling: Each seed generates a random permutation without replacement; take its batch-size prefix. Same seeds across sizes, nested inputs; overlap between batches is allowed. No partial batches.
method.statistic: Median across per-batch latency medians; p10/p90 across those medians describe input-composition variation, not a confidence interval.
method.timing: perf_counter_ns around one public API call, CUDA synchronize before and after; output release outside timing; alternating backend order across repeats
method.validation: Every measured batch exact-compared with Vesin using sorted (source,target,Sx,Sy,Sz) keys outside timing
method.vesin: reused NeighborList; CUDA per-structure compute with batch offsets and concatenation included
